definitions.explanation: Placing two things side by side to highlight their differences. Emphasizes the contrasting aspects rather than similarities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{対比|たいひ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対比|たいひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The contrast between city and countryside is vividly depicted.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対比|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}→登場人物：16072_toujoujinbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内面|ないめん}→内面：11689_naimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This film skillfully uses the contrast of light and shadow to express the characters' inner lives.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{対|たい}→対：03382_tai⟧ (facing, against) + ⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧ (compare).

USAGE:
{対比|たいひ} is used both as a noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({対比|たいひ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). It emphasizes differences between two things placed side by side, unlike ⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧ (comparison), which is more neutral and can highlight both similarities and differences. {対比|たいひ} is common in literary criticism, art analysis, and academic writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対比|たいひ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to contrast
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対比|たいひ}: in contrast with ~
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧な{対比|たいひ}: vivid contrast
- {対比|たいひ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: contrast effect
- {対比|たいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なす: to form a contrast
